lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這隻木頭貓是你買的嗎？刻得好生動啊！
lines.simplified: 这只木头猫是你买的吗？刻得好生动啊！
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhī mùtou māo shì nǐ mǎi de ma? Kè de hǎo shēngdòng a!
lines.english: Did you buy this wooden cat? It is carved so vividly!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是，是我爺爺刻的。他七十歲才開始學，現在每天都在家裡刻東西。
lines.simplified: 不是，是我爷爷刻的。他七十岁才开始学，现在每天都在家里刻东西。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, shì wǒ yéye kè de. Tā qīshí suì cái kāishǐ xué, xiànzài měitiān dōu zài jiālǐ kè dōngxi.
lines.english: No, my grandfather carved it. He only started learning at seventy, and now he carves things at home every day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 連身上的毛都刻出來了，簡直跟真的一樣。你爺爺真了不起！
lines.simplified: 连身上的毛都刻出来了，简直跟真的一样。你爷爷真了不起！
lines.pinyin: Lián shēnshàng de máo dōu kè chūlái le, jiǎnzhí gēn zhēn de yíyàng. Nǐ yéye zhēn liǎobùqǐ!
lines.english: He even carved the fur on its body; it looks practically real. Your grandfather is amazing!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他聽到一定很高興。不過他常說，這些不是什麼藝術品，只是刻著玩的。
lines.simplified: 他听到一定很高兴。不过他常说，这些不是什么艺术品，只是刻着玩的。
lines.pinyin: Tā tīngdào yídìng hěn gāoxìng. Búguò tā cháng shuō, zhèxiē bú shì shénme yìshùpǐn, zhǐ shì kè zhe wán de.
lines.english: He will be glad to hear that. But he often says these are no works of art, he just carves them for fun.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他太謙虛了。這樣的作品，放在博物館裡都沒問題。
lines.simplified: 他太谦虚了。这样的作品，放在博物馆里都没问题。
lines.pinyin: Tā tài qiānxū le. Zhèyàng de zuòpǐn, fàng zài bówùguǎn lǐ dōu méi wèntí.
lines.english: He is too modest. Work like this could easily sit in a museum.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這隻木頭貓怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这只木头猫怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhè zhī mùtou māo zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of the wooden cat?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 是爺爺買回來的藝術品
choices.simplified: 是爷爷买回来的艺术品
choices.pinyin: Shì yéye mǎi huílái de yìshùpǐn.
choices.english: It is a work of art the grandfather bought.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ zhēn de māo hái kě'ài.
choices.english: It is cuter than a real cat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kè de gēn huó de māo chàbùduō.
choices.english: It is carved almost like a living cat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ shì kè zhe wán de xiǎo dōngxi.
choices.english: It is just a little thing carved for fun.

questions.why: 簡直跟真的一樣 means it looks practically like a real cat, so it is carved like a living one. The grandfather carved it himself, he did not buy it, and he says it is no work of art; she never says it is cuter than a real cat; and 只是刻著玩的 is the grandfather's modest view, which she rejects (他太謙虛了).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我上個月回到家鄉，差一點找不到自己家。
lines.simplified: 我上个月回到家乡，差一点找不到自己家。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge yuè huídào jiāxiāng, chà yìdiǎn zhǎo bú dào zìjǐ jiā.
lines.english: I went back to my hometown last month and nearly could not find my own home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 怎麼會？你不是在那裡住了十幾年嗎？
lines.simplified: 怎么会？你不是在那里住了十几年吗？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huì? Nǐ bú shì zài nàlǐ zhù le shí jǐ nián ma?
lines.english: How come? Didn't you live there for over ten years?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這幾年那裡新建設很多，好多老房子都不見了，到處都是新大樓。我簡直不認得了。
lines.simplified: 这几年那里新建设很多，好多老房子都不见了，到处都是新大楼。我简直不认得了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián nàlǐ xīn jiànshè hěn duō, hǎoduō lǎo fángzi dōu bújiàn le, dàochù dōu shì xīn dàlóu. Wǒ jiǎnzhí bú rènde le.
lines.english: There has been a lot of new construction there these years. Lots of old houses are gone and there are new buildings everywhere. I practically did not recognize it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你小時候常去的那家麵店呢？也不見了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你小时候常去的那家面店呢？也不见了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ xiǎoshíhòu cháng qù de nà jiā miàndiàn ne? Yě bújiàn le ma?
lines.english: What about the noodle shop you often went to as a child? Is it gone too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還在！老闆一看到我，就叫出了我的名字。到了那裡，我才覺得真的回家了。
lines.simplified: 还在！老板一看到我，就叫出了我的名字。到了那里，我才觉得真的回家了。
lines.pinyin: Hái zài! Lǎobǎn yí kàndào wǒ, jiù jiào chū le wǒ de míngzi. Dào le nàlǐ, wǒ cái juéde zhēn de huíjiā le.
lines.english: It is still there! The owner called out my name the moment he saw me. Only there did I feel I was really home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得家鄉現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得家乡现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde jiāxiāng xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of his hometown now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Biàn de ràng tā juéde mòshēng.
choices.english: It has become unfamiliar to him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ shèng nà jiā miàndiàn méi biàn.
choices.english: Only that noodle shop has not changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ yǐqián rènao, tā hěn xǐhuān.
choices.english: It is livelier than before and he likes it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Línjū dōu hái rènde tā.
choices.english: The neighbours all still recognize him.

questions.why: 我簡直不認得了 means the place has changed so much that it feels strange to him: 陌生. The noodle shop is one place still there, but he never says it is the only one; he does not say he likes the new buildings; and only the shop owner knew his name, not all the neighbours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下班以後要不要去河邊看夕陽？
lines.simplified: 下班以后要不要去河边看夕阳？
lines.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu yào bú yào qù hébiān kàn xīyáng?
lines.english: Shall we go to the riverside to watch the sunset after work?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 河邊人太多了。我們公司的頂樓更好，從那裡看出去，夕陽美得沒話說。
lines.simplified: 河边人太多了。我们公司的顶楼更好，从那里看出去，夕阳美得没话说。
lines.pinyin: Hébiān rén tài duō le. Wǒmen gōngsī de dǐnglóu gèng hǎo, cóng nàlǐ kàn chūqù, xīyáng měi de méi huà shuō.
lines.english: The riverside is too crowded. Our office rooftop is better: from up there the sunset is beautiful beyond words.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 公司頂樓？別的公司的人也可以上去嗎？
lines.simplified: 公司顶楼？别的公司的人也可以上去吗？
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī dǐnglóu? Bié de gōngsī de rén yě kěyǐ shàngqù ma?
lines.english: The office rooftop? Can people from other companies go up too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那裡平常不開放，得先跟管理員說一聲。我現在打電話問問他。
lines.simplified: 那里平常不开放，得先跟管理员说一声。我现在打电话问问他。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ píngcháng bù kāifàng, děi xiān gēn guǎnlǐyuán shuō yì shēng. Wǒ xiànzài dǎ diànhuà wèn wen tā.
lines.english: It is not usually open, so I have to tell the building manager first. I will call and ask him now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊。要是他說不行，我們就早點去河邊找位子。
lines.simplified: 好啊。要是他说不行，我们就早点去河边找位子。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Yàoshi tā shuō bùxíng, wǒmen jiù zǎo diǎn qù hébiān zhǎo wèizi.
lines.english: All right. If he says no, we will go to the riverside early and find a spot.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們接下來會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们接下来会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen jiēxiàlái huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will they do next?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān qù hébiān zhǎo hǎo wèizi.
choices.english: Go to the river first and find good seats.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiàbān jiù shàng dǐnglóu qù.
choices.english: Go straight up to the roof after work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān qù wèn gōngsī de tóngshì.
choices.english: Ask colleagues at the company first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先問管理員能不能上去
choices.simplified: 先问管理员能不能上去
choices.pinyin: Xiān wèn guǎnlǐyuán néng bù néng shàngqù.
choices.english: First ask the manager whether they can go up.

questions.why: The roof is 平常不開放, so he is about to phone the manager first; the river is only the plan 要是他說不行. Going straight up skips the permission, and he does not ask colleagues: the one who decides is the manager (管理員).

focus.zh: 接下來的打算；Vs 得沒話說
focus.en: what they will do next; Vs 得沒話說

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳爸媽想搬家？
lines.simplified: 听说你爸妈想搬家？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ bàmā xiǎng bānjiā?
lines.english: I hear your parents want to move?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，他們看了碼頭旁邊的一間房子，風景好得沒話說，價錢也不貴。
lines.simplified: 对啊，他们看了码头旁边的一间房子，风景好得没话说，价钱也不贵。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tāmen kàn le mǎtóu pángbiān de yì jiān fángzi, fēngjǐng hǎo de méi huà shuō, jiàqián yě bú guì.
lines.english: Yes. They looked at a house by the pier. The view is beyond words and the price is not high.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那還等什麼？
lines.simplified: 那还等什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà hái děng shénme?
lines.english: Then what are they waiting for?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是那附近沒有醫院。我爸身體不好，每個月都得去檢查。我媽說，住的地方，方便比風景重要多了。
lines.simplified: 可是那附近没有医院。我爸身体不好，每个月都得去检查。我妈说，住的地方，方便比风景重要多了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nà fùjìn méiyǒu yīyuàn. Wǒ bà shēntǐ bù hǎo, měi ge yuè dōu děi qù jiǎnchá. Wǒ mā shuō, zhù de dìfāng, fāngbiàn bǐ fēngjǐng zhòngyào duō le.
lines.english: But there is no hospital nearby. My dad's health is poor and he needs a checkup every month. My mom says that for a place to live, convenience matters far more than the view.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那他們決定了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那他们决定了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà tāmen juédìng le ma?
lines.english: So have they decided?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還沒。我媽想先找找看醫院附近有沒有合適的。
lines.simplified: 还没。我妈想先找找看医院附近有没有合适的。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Wǒ mā xiǎng xiān zhǎozhao kàn yīyuàn fùjìn yǒu méi yǒu héshì de.
lines.english: Not yet. My mom wants to look first for something suitable near a hospital.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的媽媽選房子的時候，覺得什麼最重要？
prompt.simplified: 女的妈妈选房子的时候，觉得什么最重要？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de māma xuǎn fángzi de shíhòu, juéde shénme zuì zhòngyào?
prompt.english: When choosing a house, what does the woman's mother think matters most?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chuāng wài de fēngjǐng yào měi.
choices.english: The view outside must be beautiful.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kàn yīshēng yào fāngbiàn.
choices.english: Seeing a doctor must be easy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fángzi de jiàqián yào piányí.
choices.english: The house must be cheap.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào lí mǎtóu jìn yìdiǎn.
choices.english: It must be close to the pier.

questions.why: The view is 好得沒話說, yet the mother says convenience matters more than the view, and with the father's monthly checkups that means being near a hospital. The view and the low price are what make the pier house tempting, not what she puts first.

focus.zh: Vs 得沒話說；兩句合起來

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上星期去面試導遊的工作，結果怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你上星期去面试导游的工作，结果怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng xīngqí qù miànshì dǎoyóu de gōngzuò, jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: You had an interview for a tour guide job last week. How did it go?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 儘管我準備了很久，面試的時候還是緊張得說不出話來。
lines.simplified: 尽管我准备了很久，面试的时候还是紧张得说不出话来。
lines.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, miànshì de shíhòu háishì jǐnzhāng de shuō bù chū huà lái.
lines.english: Even though I prepared for a long time, I was so nervous in the interview I could hardly speak.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那不就沒希望了？
lines.simplified: 那不就没希望了？
lines.pinyin: Nà bú jiù méi xīwàng le?
lines.english: Then isn't it hopeless?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我也以為是這樣。沒想到經理說，第一次面試的人往往都很緊張，他比較想知道我對這裡的古蹟了解多少。
lines.simplified: 我也以为是这样。没想到经理说，第一次面试的人往往都很紧张，他比较想知道我对这里的古迹了解多少。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǐwéi shì zhèyàng. Méi xiǎngdào jīnglǐ shuō, dì yī cì miànshì de rén wǎngwǎng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng, tā bǐjiào xiǎng zhīdào wǒ duì zhèlǐ de gǔjī liǎojiě duōshǎo.
lines.english: I thought so too. But the manager said people at their first interview are often nervous; he cared more about how much I know about the historic sites here.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳回答得出來嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你回答得出来吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ huídá de chūlái ma?
lines.english: And could you answer?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那是我最熟的部分。下星期一我就開始上班了。
lines.simplified: 那是我最熟的部分。下星期一我就开始上班了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ zuì shú de bùfèn. Xià xīngqíyī wǒ jiù kāishǐ shàngbān le.
lines.english: That is the part I know best. I start work next Monday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi de bú gòu cái jǐnzhāng.
choices.english: She was nervous because she had not prepared enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理覺得她緊張很正常
choices.simplified: 经理觉得她紧张很正常
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ juéde tā jǐnzhāng hěn zhèngcháng.
choices.english: The manager thought her nerves were normal.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理的問題她都回答不出來
choices.simplified: 经理的问题她都回答不出来
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ de wèntí tā dōu huídá bù chūlái.
choices.english: She could not answer any of the manager's questions.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xià xīngqíyī yào zài miànshì.
choices.english: She has another interview next Monday.

questions.why: 往往都很緊張 means first-time interviewees are often nervous, so the manager saw her nerves as normal. 儘管我準備了很久 rules out "not prepared enough"; the history questions were her strongest part; next Monday she starts work, not another interview.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的牙齒還痛嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的牙齿还痛吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de yáchǐ hái tòng ma?
lines.english: Does your tooth still hurt?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好多了。上個月就開始痛了，可是我一直不想去看醫生。
lines.simplified: 好多了。上个月就开始痛了，可是我一直不想去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo duō le. Shàng ge yuè jiù kāishǐ tòng le, kěshì wǒ yìzhí bù xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: Much better. It started hurting last month, but I kept not wanting to see a doctor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我不是一再提醒你了嗎？
lines.simplified: 我不是一再提醒你了吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì yízài tíxǐng nǐ le ma?
lines.english: Didn't I remind you again and again?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，直到前天晚上痛得睡不著，我才去。醫生說，假如再晚一點去，牙齒可能就留不住了。
lines.simplified: 对啊，直到前天晚上痛得睡不着，我才去。医生说，假如再晚一点去，牙齿可能就留不住了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, zhídào qiántiān wǎnshàng tòng de shuì bù zháo, wǒ cái qù. Yīshēng shuō, jiǎrú zài wǎn yìdiǎn qù, yáchǐ kěnéng jiù liú bú zhù le.
lines.english: Yes. I only went when it hurt so much the night before last that I could not sleep. The doctor said that if I had gone any later, the tooth might not have been saved.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 幸好你去了。下次可別再等那麼久了。
lines.simplified: 幸好你去了。下次可别再等那么久了。
lines.pinyin: Xìnghǎo nǐ qù le. Xià cì kě bié zài děng nàme jiǔ le.
lines.english: Luckily you went. Next time don't wait that long again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼前天才去看醫生？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么前天才去看医生？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme qiántiān cái qù kàn yīshēng?
prompt.english: Why did the man only see a doctor the day before yesterday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yízài tíxǐng tā.
choices.english: The woman reminded him again and again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà yá huì liú bú zhù.
choices.english: He was afraid of losing the tooth.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè jiù tòng de shòubùliǎo.
choices.english: It was already unbearable last month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā tòng dào wǎnshàng méi bànfǎ shuì.
choices.english: The pain kept him from sleeping at night.

questions.why: 直到前天晚上痛得睡不著，我才去: only the sleepless night made him go. She had reminded him again and again (一再) without effect; the danger of losing the tooth is what the doctor said AFTER he went; last month the pain only began, it was not yet unbearable.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個展的主題是人類最早的文字。聽說有一些字到現在還是個祕密，連研究人員都看不懂。
lines.simplified: 这个展的主题是人类最早的文字。听说有一些字到现在还是个秘密，连研究人员都看不懂。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhǎn de zhǔtí shì rénlèi zuì zǎo de wénzì. Tīngshuō yǒu yìxiē zì dào xiànzài hái shì ge mìmì, lián yánjiù rényuán dōu kàn bù dǒng.
lines.english: The theme of this exhibition is humanity's earliest writing. I hear some of the characters are still a secret today; even researchers cannot read them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們先去地下那一層吧，最古老的物品都放在那裡。
lines.simplified: 那我们先去地下那一层吧，最古老的物品都放在那里。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān qù dìxià nà yì céng ba, zuì gǔlǎo de wùpǐn dōu fàng zài nàlǐ.
lines.english: Then let's go to the basement floor first. The oldest objects are all there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我上次去過。那裡的燈很暗，連旁邊說明的文字都看不清楚。
lines.simplified: 我上次去过。那里的灯很暗，连旁边说明的文字都看不清楚。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì qù guo. Nàlǐ de dēng hěn àn, lián pángbiān shuōmíng de wénzì dōu kàn bù qīngchǔ.
lines.english: I went last time. The lights there are dim; you cannot even read the labels beside the objects.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: So what do we do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 門口可以借小燈，我們先去拿兩個。
lines.simplified: 门口可以借小灯，我们先去拿两个。
lines.pinyin: Ménkǒu kěyǐ jiè xiǎo dēng, wǒmen xiān qù ná liǎng ge.
lines.english: You can borrow small lamps at the entrance. Let's go and get two first.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好。看完以後，我還想去看那張有名的圖畫。看過的人都說，那張畫美得沒辦法用文字形容。
lines.simplified: 好。看完以后，我还想去看那张有名的图画。看过的人都说，那张画美得没办法用文字形容。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Kàn wán yǐhòu, wǒ hái xiǎng qù kàn nà zhāng yǒumíng de túhuà. Kàn guo de rén dōu shuō, nà zhāng huà měi de méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì xíngróng.
lines.english: OK. Afterwards I also want to see that famous painting. Everyone who has seen it says it is too beautiful to describe in words.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那張畫這個月不在，被借到國外的博物館去了，下個月才回來。
lines.simplified: 那张画这个月不在，被借到国外的博物馆去了，下个月才回来。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhāng huà zhège yuè bú zài, bèi jiè dào guówài de bówùguǎn qù le, xià ge yuè cái huílái.
lines.english: That painting is away this month. It has been lent to a museum abroad and only comes back next month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真可惜，那就下個月再來吧。我們先去拿燈。
lines.simplified: 真可惜，那就下个月再来吧。我们先去拿灯。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn kěxí, nà jiù xià ge yuè zài lái ba. Wǒmen xiān qù ná dēng.
lines.english: What a pity. Then let's come back next month. Let's go and get the lamps first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼要先到門口去？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么要先到门口去？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme yào xiān dào ménkǒu qù?
prompt.english: Why do they go to the entrance first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiàmiàn tài àn, yào jiè dēng kàn zì.
choices.english: It is too dark downstairs; they need lamps to read.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào xiān qù kàn nà zhāng huà.
choices.english: They want to see the painting first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuì zǎo de wénzì fàng zài ménkǒu.
choices.english: The earliest writing is at the entrance.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要問研究人員字的意思
choices.simplified: 要问研究人员字的意思
choices.pinyin: Yào wèn yánjiù rényuán zì de yìsi.
choices.english: To ask the researchers what the writing means.

questions.why: He says the basement is so dim that even the labels cannot be read, and lamps can be borrowed at the entrance. The painting comes after the basement (and is away), the oldest objects are downstairs, not at the entrance, and the researchers are mentioned only because they cannot read some of the writing either.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的今天為什麼看不到那張畫？
prompt.simplified: 女的今天为什么看不到那张画？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jīntiān wèishénme kàn bú dào nà zhāng huà?
prompt.english: Why can't the woman see the painting today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà fàng zài dēng hěn àn de dìxià.
choices.english: The painting is in the dim basement.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà hái méi cóng guówài jiè lái.
choices.english: The painting has not been borrowed from abroad yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà zhànshí zài bié de guójiā.
choices.english: The painting is in another country for now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà zhège yuè zhèngzài xiūlǐ.
choices.english: The painting is being repaired this month.

questions.why: 被借到國外的博物館去了，下個月才回來: the museum's own painting is on loan abroad for now. It is lent OUT, not waiting to be borrowed IN; the dim basement is where the old objects are; nobody says it is being repaired.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān xiān kàn huà zài qù dìxià.
choices.english: Today, see the painting first, then the basement.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下個月再來看地下那層
choices.simplified: 下个月再来看地下那层
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè zài lái kàn dìxià nà céng.
choices.english: Come back next month to see the basement floor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìxià tài àn, gǎitiān zài lái.
choices.english: The basement is too dark; come another day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今天看地下，下個月來看畫
choices.simplified: 今天看地下，下个月来看画
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān kàn dìxià, xià ge yuè lái kàn huà.
choices.english: See the basement today and come back next month for the painting.

questions.why: The painting is abroad until next month, so 那就下個月再來吧 is for the painting, and 先去拿燈 means the lamps for the dark basement: the basement today, the painting next month. The painting cannot be seen first today; next month is for the painting, not the basement; and the lamps solve the dark, so the basement is not put off.

focus.zh: 說話人的決定；幾句合起來
focus.en: the speaker's decision; several turns together

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳書桌上這個拼圖，是淡水的紅毛城吧？我一看就認得出來。
lines.simplified: 你书桌上这个拼图，是淡水的红毛城吧？我一看就认得出来。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shūzhuō shàng zhège pīntú, shì Dànshuǐ de Hóngmáochéng ba? Wǒ yí kàn jiù rèn de chūlái.
lines.english: The jigsaw puzzle on your desk is Fort San Domingo in Tamsui, right? I recognized it at once.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，旁邊還有碼頭跟夕陽。一共一千片，我已經拼了兩個星期了。
lines.simplified: 对，旁边还有码头跟夕阳。一共一千片，我已经拼了两个星期了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, pángbiān hái yǒu mǎtóu gēn xīyáng. Yígòng yìqiān piàn, wǒ yǐjīng pīn le liǎng ge xīngqí le.
lines.english: Yes, with the pier and the sunset beside it. A thousand pieces in all; I have been putting it together for two weeks.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 兩個星期？那妳不是每天都拼到半夜？
lines.simplified: 两个星期？那你不是每天都拼到半夜？
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge xīngqí? Nà nǐ bú shì měitiān dōu pīn dào bànyè?
lines.english: Two weeks? So you have been at it till midnight every day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒有。我只在睡覺前拼半個小時。拼的同時，心情也慢慢變好了。
lines.simplified: 没有。我只在睡觉前拼半个小时。拼的同时，心情也慢慢变好了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Wǒ zhǐ zài shuìjiào qián pīn bàn ge xiǎoshí. Pīn de tóngshí, xīnqíng yě mànmàn biàn hǎo le.
lines.english: No. I only do half an hour before bed. While I piece it together, my mood slowly gets better too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 看起來最難的是天空吧？
lines.simplified: 看起来最难的是天空吧？
lines.pinyin: Kàn qǐlái zuì nán de shì tiānkōng ba?
lines.english: The sky looks like the hardest part, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。有好幾片拼圖的顏色都一樣，有時候一片就得找十幾分鐘。
lines.simplified: 对啊。有好几片拼图的颜色都一样，有时候一片就得找十几分钟。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Yǒu hǎo jǐ piàn pīntú de yánsè dōu yíyàng, yǒu shíhòu yí piàn jiù děi zhǎo shí jǐ fēnzhōng.
lines.english: Yes. Lots of the pieces are the same colour; sometimes one piece takes over ten minutes to find.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我來幫妳拼天空吧。
lines.simplified: 那我来帮你拼天空吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ lái bāng nǐ pīn tiānkōng ba.
lines.english: Then let me help you with the sky.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 謝謝，不過我想一片一片自己拼完。你要是有興趣，我還有一個小的，可以送你。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，不过我想一片一片自己拼完。你要是有兴趣，我还有一个小的，可以送你。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, búguò wǒ xiǎng yí piàn yí piàn zìjǐ pīn wán. Nǐ yàoshi yǒu xìngqù, wǒ hái yǒu yí ge xiǎo de, kěyǐ sòng nǐ.
lines.english: Thanks, but I want to finish it myself, piece by piece. If you are interested, I have a small one I can give you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的拼拼圖的情形，下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 女的拼拼图的情形，下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de pīn pīntú de qíngxíng, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: About how the woman is doing her jigsaw puzzle, which is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng pīn le liǎng ge yuè.
choices.english: She has been doing it for two months.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā dōu zài shuìjiào qián pīn yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She does a little before going to sleep.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 天空的部分已經拼好了
choices.simplified: 天空的部分已经拼好了
choices.pinyin: Tiānkōng de bùfen yǐjīng pīn hǎo le.
choices.english: The sky part is already done.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pīn hǎo yǐhòu yào sòng gěi nán de.
choices.english: She will give it to the man when it is done.

questions.why: She does only half an hour 睡覺前, before going to sleep. It has been two weeks, not two months; the sky is still the hard part the man offers to help with; and what she would give him is another, smaller puzzle, not this one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 拼天空為什麼特別花時間？
prompt.simplified: 拼天空为什么特别花时间？
prompt.pinyin: Pīn tiānkōng wèishénme tèbié huā shíjiān?
prompt.english: Why does the sky take so long?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tiānkōng nà yí kuài tèbié dà.
choices.english: The sky part is especially big.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā měitiān zhǐ pīn bàn xiǎoshí.
choices.english: She only does half an hour a day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīyáng gēn tiānkōng yánsè yíyàng.
choices.english: The sunset is the same colour as the sky.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn duō piàn kàn qǐlái chàbùduō.
choices.english: Many pieces look nearly the same.

questions.why: Asked about the sky, she says many pieces have the same colour, so one piece can take ten minutes to find. Half an hour a day explains the two weeks, not the sky; nobody says the sky part is big; 顏色都一樣 is about the sky pieces, not the sunset matching the sky.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說要幫忙，女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说要帮忙，女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō yào bāngmáng, nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: When the man offers to help, what does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhège tā yào yí ge rén wánchéng.
choices.english: She wants to finish this one on her own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng tā xiān pīn tiānkōng.
choices.english: She hopes he will do the sky first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng gēn tā yìqǐ pīn xiǎo de.
choices.english: She wants to do the small one with him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà tā pīn de tài màn.
choices.english: She is afraid he is too slow.

questions.why: 我想一片一片自己拼完 is a polite no: she wants to finish this one alone. She offers him the small puzzle to keep (送你), not to do together, and nothing suggests she thinks he is slow.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友午安。從這個星期六開始，城裡的博物館有一個宗教藝術展。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友午安。从这个星期六开始，城里的博物馆有一个宗教艺术展。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǔ'ān. Cóng zhège xīngqíliù kāishǐ, chéng lǐ de bówùguǎn yǒu yí ge zōngjiào yìshù zhǎn.
lines.english: Good afternoon, listeners. From this Saturday, the museum in town has an exhibition of religious art.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個展有佛教、道教、天主教及基督教的藝術品一百多件，有一些已經存在五百年以上了。
lines.simplified: 这个展有佛教、道教、天主教及基督教的艺术品一百多件，有一些已经存在五百年以上了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhǎn yǒu Fójiào, Dàojiào, Tiānzhǔjiào jí Jīdūjiào de yìshùpǐn yìbǎi duō jiàn, yǒu yìxiē yǐjīng cúnzài wǔbǎi nián yǐshàng le.
lines.english: It holds more than a hundred works of Buddhist, Taoist, Catholic and Protestant art, some of which have existed for over five hundred years.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 其中最著名的，是一張畫在布上的天主教作品。三百年前，一位國王把它當成外交禮物，送給了別的國家。這是它第一次來台灣。
lines.simplified: 其中最著名的，是一张画在布上的天主教作品。三百年前，一位国王把它当成外交礼物，送给了别的国家。这是它第一次来台湾。
lines.pinyin: Qízhōng zuì zhùmíng de, shì yì zhāng huà zài bù shàng de Tiānzhǔjiào zuòpǐn. Sānbǎi nián qián, yí wèi guówáng bǎ tā dāngchéng wàijiāo lǐwù, sòng gěi le bié de guójiā. Zhè shì tā dì yī cì lái Táiwān.
lines.english: The most famous is a Catholic work painted on cloth. Three hundred years ago a king gave it to another country as a diplomatic gift. This is its first time in Taiwan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 六十五歲以上的老人家及學生可以免費參觀，其他的人一張票一百五十元。
lines.simplified: 六十五岁以上的老人家及学生可以免费参观，其他的人一张票一百五十元。
lines.pinyin: Liùshíwǔ suì yǐshàng de lǎorénjiā jí xuéshēng kěyǐ miǎnfèi cānguān, qítā de rén yì zhāng piào yìbǎi wǔshí yuán.
lines.english: People aged sixty-five and over, as well as students, get in free; for everyone else a ticket is one hundred and fifty dollars.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 因為有一些物品十分容易壞，博物館裡不能照相，也請大家不要用手碰。
lines.simplified: 因为有一些物品十分容易坏，博物馆里不能照相，也请大家不要用手碰。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu yìxiē wùpǐn shífēn róngyì huài, bówùguǎn lǐ bù néng zhàoxiàng, yě qǐng dàjiā bú yào yòng shǒu pèng.
lines.english: Because some items break very easily, no photos are allowed in the galleries, and please do not touch anything.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個展到十二月三十一號，每個星期一休館。
lines.simplified: 这个展到十二月三十一号，每个星期一休馆。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhǎn dào shí'èr yuè sānshíyī hào, měi ge xīngqíyī xiūguǎn.
lines.english: The exhibition runs until December 31st and is closed every Monday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那張最著名的作品，下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 那张最著名的作品，下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nà zhāng zuì zhùmíng de zuòpǐn, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: About the most famous work, which is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Táiwān sānbǎi nián qián de huà.
choices.english: A Taiwanese painting from three hundred years ago.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bié de guójiā sòng gěi Táiwān de.
choices.english: A gift from another country to Taiwan.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Guówáng sòng chūqù de lǐwù.
choices.english: A gift a king sent abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǔbǎi nián qián de zōngjiào huà.
choices.english: A religious painting from five hundred years ago.

questions.why: It was a 外交禮物 a king sent to another country. It is in Taiwan for the first time, so it is neither Taiwanese nor a gift to Taiwan, and 五百年以上 is the age of some other pieces; this one is three hundred years old.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一位可以不買票進去參觀？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一位可以不买票进去参观？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí wèi kěyǐ bù mǎi piào jìnqù cānguān?
prompt.english: Which of these people can go in without buying a ticket?

choices.pinyin: Yí wèi liùshí suì de lǎoshī.
choices.english: A sixty-year-old teacher.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí wèi èrshí suì de dàxuéshēng.
choices.english: A twenty-year-old university student.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī lái de lǎorénjiā.
choices.english: An elderly person who comes on a Monday.

choices.speaker: N

passage.pinyin: Wàipó de lǎojiā zài hǎibiān yí ge xiǎo chéng. Yì bǎi nián qián, chéng lǐ de mǎtou yǒu hǎoxiē chuán jìnchū, shífēn rènao, hòulái méi rén qù le. Xìnghǎo yǒu jǐ wèi lǎorén yìzhí zài zhěnglǐ, mǎtou cái liú dào xiànzài. Qùnián, yǒu rén jiànyì bǎ mǎtou gǎi chéng tíngchēchǎng, shìzhǎng què juédìng bǎoliú mǎtou, qǐng rén xiūlǐ, tóngshí zài pángbiān de lǎo fángzi lǐ jièshào tā de lìshǐ. Shàng ge yuè péi wàipó huíqù, jǐnguǎn guò le liùshí nián, tā háishì yì yǎn jiù zhǎo dào le nà kuài shítou, xiǎoshíhòu tā cháng zuò zài nàlǐ děng fùqīn de chuán. Wǒ zhè cái tǐhuì dào, mǎtou duì wàipó lái shuō bù zhǐ shì gǔjī, gèng shì huíyì. Jiǎrú méi péi tā huílái, wǒ kǒngpà yǒngyuǎn bú huì zhīdào zhèxiē shì.
passage.english: My grandmother's old home is in a small town by the sea. A hundred years ago, quite a few boats came in and out of the town's pier and it was very lively, but later nobody went there any more. Luckily a few old people kept tidying and mending it, and only because of that has the pier lasted until now. Last year someone suggested turning the pier into a car park, but the mayor decided to keep the pier, had it repaired, and at the same time set up an introduction to the pier's history in the old house next to it. Last month I went back with my grandmother. Even though sixty years have passed, she found the stone at a glance; as a child she often sat there waiting for her father's boat. Only then did I realize that to my grandmother the pier is not just a historic site; even more, it is her memories. If I had not gone back with her, I would probably never have known any of this.

Měi tiáo lóng dōu zuò de shífēn shēngdòng, jiǎnzhí xiàng yào dòng qǐlái yíyàng. Hěn duō rén yǐwéi tā jiē dào gōngzuò jiù mǎshàng kāishǐ, tā què xiān huā hǎo jǐ ge yuè yánjiù gǔshū jí lǎo zhàopiàn. Lái cānguān de rén kàn le tā de zuòpǐn, dōu shuō tā hěn liǎobùqǐ, kěshì tā yìdiǎn yě bù jiāo'ào, zhǐ shuō zìjǐ hái yǒu hěn duō yào xué. Zǒngzhī, zài wǒ kàn lái, tā zuò de měi tiáo lóng dōu bù zhǐ shì shítou, ér shì yí jiànjiàn yìshùpǐn.
passage.english: On the square in front of the temple there is an old man in his seventies who began carving stone at fifteen; most of the stone dragons in the temple are his work. Every dragon is made extremely vivid; they practically look about to move. Many people think he starts work as soon as he gets a job, but he first spends several months studying old books and old photos. He says that only by working according to the look the people of the past left will a historic site not lose its original feel. Visitors who see his work all say he is amazing, but he is not proud at all and only says he still has a lot to learn. In short, to my mind, every dragon he makes is not just stone but a work of art.

text.traditional:
小城北邊有一座兩百多年前因為戰爭而蓋的城門。戰爭結束以來，它一直站在那裡，看著人們在這塊土地上居住、工作。去年，市長決定在這裡開一條新馬路，而城門剛好在路的中間，因此很可能就要不見了。
消息傳出以後，城裡的人看法很不一樣。絕大部分的年輕人都同意蓋新路，他們認為：首先，有了新路，交通會方便很多；其次，城門已經很舊了，每年只是為了讓它維持良好的狀態，就得花不少經費。可是好些老人家聽了都很難過。一位八十歲的老先生說，這座城門讓人看到祖先怎麼用智慧保護家鄉，同時也是城裡每個人的回憶，它具有的價值不能只用錢來算。
事實上，一個國家的人民往往會因為自己的古蹟而覺得驕傲，一座小城也是這樣。我認為，市長應該積極地跟大家溝通，找出新的辦法。總而言之，路可以換個地方蓋，城門卻只有一座。
text.simplified:
小城北边有一座两百多年前因为战争而盖的城门。战争结束以来，它一直站在那里，看着人们在这块土地上居住、工作。去年，市长决定在这里开一条新马路，而城门刚好在路的中间，因此很可能就要不见了。
消息传出以后，城里的人看法很不一样。绝大部分的年轻人都同意盖新路，他们认为：首先，有了新路，交通会方便很多；其次，城门已经很旧了，每年只是为了让它维持良好的状态，就得花不少经费。可是好些老人家听了都很难过。一位八十岁的老先生说，这座城门让人看到祖先怎么用智慧保护家乡，同时也是城里每个人的回忆，它具有的价值不能只用钱来算。
事实上，一个国家的人民往往会因为自己的古迹而觉得骄傲，一座小城也是这样。我认为，市长应该积极地跟大家沟通，找出新的办法。总而言之，路可以换个地方盖，城门却只有一座。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo chéng běibiān yǒu yí zuò liǎng bǎi duō nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér gài de chéngmén. Zhànzhēng jiéshù yǐlái, tā yìzhí zhàn zài nàlǐ, kàn zhe rénmen zài zhè kuài tǔdì shàng jūzhù, gōngzuò. Qùnián, shìzhǎng juédìng zài zhèlǐ kāi yì tiáo xīn mǎlù, ér chéngmén gānghǎo zài lù de zhōngjiān, yīncǐ hěn kěnéng jiù yào bú jiàn le. Xiāoxí chuán chū yǐhòu, chéng lǐ de rén kànfǎ hěn bù yíyàng. Juédàbùfèn de niánqīng rén dōu tóngyì gài xīn lù, tāmen rènwéi: shǒuxiān, yǒu le xīn lù, jiāotōng huì fāngbiàn hěn duō; qícì, chéngmén yǐjīng hěn jiù le, měi nián zhǐ shì wèile ràng tā wéichí liánghǎo de zhuàngtài, jiù děi huā bù shǎo jīngfèi. Kěshì hǎoxiē lǎorénjiā tīng le dōu hěn nánguò. Yí wèi bāshí suì de lǎo xiānshēng shuō, zhè zuò chéngmén ràng rén kàn dào zǔxiān zěnme yòng zhìhuì bǎohù jiāxiāng, tóngshí yě shì chéng lǐ měi ge rén de huíyì, tā jùyǒu de jiàzhí bù néng zhǐ yòng qián lái suàn. Shìshíshàng, yí ge guójiā de rénmín wǎngwǎng huì yīnwèi zìjǐ de gǔjī ér juéde jiāo'ào, yí zuò xiǎo chéng yě shì zhèyàng. Wǒ rènwéi, shìzhǎng yīnggāi jījí de gēn dàjiā gōutōng, zhǎo chū xīn de bànfǎ. Zǒng'ér yánzhī, lù kěyǐ huàn ge dìfāng gài, chéngmén què zhǐ yǒu yí zuò.
text.english:
North of the small town stands a city gate built over two hundred years ago because of a war. Since the war ended it has stood there, watching people live and work on this land. Last year the mayor decided to build a new road here, and the gate happens to stand in the middle of it, so it may well be about to disappear.
Once the news got out, people in the town saw it very differently. Most of the young people agree to building the new road. They think that, first, with a new road traffic will be much easier; second, the gate is already very old, and just keeping it in good condition costs a lot of money every year. But quite a few old people were very sad to hear it. An eighty-year-old man said that the gate lets people see how their ancestors used their wisdom to protect their hometown, and at the same time it is the memory of everyone in the town; the value it has cannot be measured in money alone.
In fact, a country's people are often proud of their own historic sites, and a small town is the same. I think the mayor should actively talk things over with everyone and find a new solution. In a word, a road can be built somewhere else, but there is only one gate.

title.pinyin: Yì bǎi nián qián de túhuà
title.english: Drawings from a Hundred Years Ago

text.traditional:
一百多年前，有一位外國的外交人員在台灣工作。他很喜歡到各地參觀寺廟，可是不太會寫中文，就用圖畫把看到的東西記錄下來。自從他回國以來，這些圖畫就一直留在他的老家，很少人知道它們的存在。
十年前，小城的一座古廟發生火災，廟裡好些木門被燒掉，石龍也被大火弄壞了。管理古廟的人雖然很快就找到了經費，卻不知道該怎麼修，因為留下來的老照片很少，文字的記錄也只有短短一句：「龍刻得十分生動」。只有這樣的形容，誰也做不出原來的樣子。
幸好，一位研究歷史的教授在國外尋找資料的時候，發現了那位外交人員的圖畫。圖畫裡，連龍身上每一個小地方都畫得很清楚。專業人員按照這些圖畫，花了三年才讓古廟恢復到火災以前的樣子。
這件事讓他們體會到，修古蹟事實上不只需要經費，平時的記錄也一樣重要。現在，他們除了讓古廟維持良好的狀態，同時也為每件物品照相、記下大小，再把照片和大小放到網路上。總之，今天多留下一點記錄，以後的人就少一點煩惱。
text.simplified:
一百多年前，有一位外国的外交人员在台湾工作。他很喜欢到各地参观寺庙，可是不太会写中文，就用图画把看到的东西记录下来。自从他回国以来，这些图画就一直留在他的老家，很少人知道它们的存在。
十年前，小城的一座古庙发生火灾，庙里好些木门被烧掉，石龙也被大火弄坏了。管理古庙的人虽然很快就找到了经费，却不知道该怎么修，因为留下来的老照片很少，文字的记录也只有短短一句：「龙刻得十分生动」。只有这样的形容，谁也做不出原来的样子。
幸好，一位研究历史的教授在国外寻找资料的时候，发现了那位外交人员的图画。图画里，连龙身上每一个小地方都画得很清楚。专业人员按照这些图画，花了三年才让古庙恢复到火灾以前的样子。
这件事让他们体会到，修古迹事实上不只需要经费，平时的记录也一样重要。现在，他们除了让古庙维持良好的状态，同时也为每件物品照相、记下大小，再把照片和大小放到网路上。总之，今天多留下一点记录，以后的人就少一点烦恼。
text.pinyin: Yì bǎi duō nián qián, yǒu yí wèi wàiguó de wàijiāo rényuán zài Táiwān gōngzuò. Tā hěn xǐhuān dào gèdì cānguān sìmiào, kěshì bú tài huì xiě Zhōngwén, jiù yòng túhuà bǎ kàn dào de dōngxi jìlù xiàlái. Zìcóng tā huí guó yǐlái, zhèxiē túhuà jiù yìzhí liú zài tā de lǎojiā, hěn shǎo rén zhīdào tāmen de cúnzài. Shí nián qián, xiǎo chéng de yí zuò gǔ miào fāshēng huǒzāi, miào lǐ hǎoxiē mù mén bèi shāo diào, shí lóng yě bèi dàhuǒ nòng huài le. Guǎnlǐ gǔ miào de rén suīrán hěn kuài jiù zhǎo dào le jīngfèi, què bù zhīdào gāi zěnme xiū, yīnwèi liú xiàlái de lǎo zhàopiàn hěn shǎo, wénzì de jìlù yě zhǐ yǒu duǎnduǎn yí jù: "Lóng kè de shífēn shēngdòng." Zhǐ yǒu zhèyàng de xíngróng, shéi yě zuò bù chū yuánlái de yàngzi. Xìnghǎo, yí wèi yánjiù lìshǐ de jiàoshòu zài guówài xúnzhǎo zīliào de shíhòu, fāxiàn le nà wèi wàijiāo rényuán de túhuà. Túhuà lǐ, lián lóng shēnshàng měi yí ge xiǎo dìfāng dōu huà de hěn qīngchǔ. Zhuānyè rényuán ànzhào zhèxiē túhuà, huā le sān nián cái ràng gǔ miào huīfù dào huǒzāi yǐqián de yàngzi. Zhè jiàn shì ràng tāmen tǐhuì dào, xiū gǔjī shìshíshàng bù zhǐ xūyào jīngfèi, píngshí de jìlù yě yíyàng zhòngyào. Xiànzài, tāmen chúle ràng gǔ miào wéichí liánghǎo de zhuàngtài, tóngshí yě wèi měi jiàn wùpǐn zhàoxiàng, jì xià dàxiǎo, zài bǎ zhàopiàn hé dàxiǎo fàng dào wǎnglù shàng. Zǒngzhī, jīntiān duō liú xià yìdiǎn jìlù, yǐhòu de rén jiù shǎo yìdiǎn fánnǎo.
text.english:
Over a hundred years ago, a foreign diplomat worked in Taiwan. He loved visiting temples all over the island, but he could not write much Chinese, so he recorded what he saw in drawings. Ever since he went home, the drawings have been kept in his old family home, and few people knew they existed.
Ten years ago a fire broke out in an old temple in a small town, and quite a few of the temple's wooden doors burnt down, and its stone dragons were damaged by the fire. Although the people in charge quickly found the funds, they did not know how to repair them, because few old photos were left and the written record was just one short line: "The dragons are carved extremely vividly." With nothing but a description like that, nobody could make them as they had been.
Luckily, a history professor searching for material abroad found the diplomat's drawings. In them, even every small part of the dragons is drawn clearly. Following these drawings, professionals took three years to bring the temple back to how it was before the fire.
This taught them that repairing a historic site in fact needs more than money: everyday records matter just as much. Now, besides keeping the temple in good condition, at the same time they photograph every object, note its size, and put the photos and sizes online. In short, the more records we leave today, the fewer worries people will have later.
